elements.element: New York law governs the Agreement.
elements.evidence: Section 28.1 expressly provides that the Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York.

elements.element: State and federal courts in New York County have exclusive jurisdiction.
elements.evidence: Section 28.2 grants those courts exclusive jurisdiction but permits either Party to seek temporary injunctive relief in another court, so exclusivity is subject to an express exception.

elements.element: The governing law is Delaware, California, or England and Wales.
elements.evidence: The governing law is New York, not Delaware, California, or England and Wales.

elements.element: The dispute forum is the corresponding Delaware or California courts, or the courts of London for England and Wales law.
elements.evidence: The specified forum is New York County, with a limited provisional-relief carveout, not any listed fallback forum.
